prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Customize your pet's official desktop companion certificate.", "Certificate Preview", "Certified Desktop Companion"]
1: ["How to Interact with Your Desktop Pet", "Learn how to summon, minimize, and chat with your companion directly on your desktop.", "Click pet to chat | Press Alt+P to toggle display | Right-click for menu", "Got It!"]
2: ["Upload Photo or Choose a Preset Pet", "If photo generation is slow or failing, tap below to pick from our verified pet styles.", "Choose a Instant Backup Preset", "Instant presets skip generation wait times!"]
3: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion Experience", "Discover how your pet will live right on your desktop screen.", "Pick Your Onboarding Path"]
4: ["Signing in binds your pet securely to your account so you never lose your progress or custom companion.", "Cloud Pet Sync Enabled"]
5: ["Initializing Desktop Companion Engine...", "Setting up desktop overlay and animation system...", "Ensure app permissions allow desktop overlay for your pet to render smoothly."]
6: ["Adopt Your Desktop Pet in 60 Seconds", "Select a quick starter path below to meet your new desktop buddy immediately.", "Start Quick Setup"]
7: ["Meet Your Future Desktop Friend", "Interactive Companion Preview"]
8: ["Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!", "Display Active | Audio Enabled | Drag & Drop Ready", "Test Companion Sound"]
9: ["Certificate Granted + Free Starter Item!", "Bonus Gift: Golden Collar Unlocked!"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras and bonus gifts.
